manifest.protocol: Independent sequential processes. Alternating baseline/optimized and worker-count order. Service includes allocation/reset, search and complete path reconstruction. All measured batches checked against the optimal oracle outside timers. Result bytes must match between variants, processes and worker counts.

aggregation: Median of per-process mean/p95/throughput, each aggregated independently. Quality counts each distinct query once. All process outliers retained.

reset_profile.interpretation: Separate instrumented run, eight alternating batches after two warm-ups. Not query benchmark data.

limitations: Uncontrolled machine scheduling/load; substantial process-to-process variation. No outlier exclusion.
Touched resets and heap reuse reduce resource initialization but do not guarantee lower total query latency.
Service time includes full result path construction; queue wait is excluded. Throughput uses batch wall time.
Peak RSS includes graph, workers and all retained results for a batch, not just workspace storage.
The first and final trials use different binaries and durations. No causal end-to-end speedup claim is made from their medians.
